color.evidence: Fold: paper/mist/deep/void; headings on --deep; filled CTAs on --action; links on --blue; mist is blue-tinted. Audit: 0/81 contrast fails, 5 bg colors, 7 text colors, CTA hue 218, no purple. Header Request a quote is ghost so fold has one solid act target.
strengths: Mist is brand-tinted grey, not default gray
Filled --action limited to primary buttons; header CTA is ghost

issues.problem: --action #013ea8 and --blue #0154a7 are almost the same lightness, so links and buttons share one blue.
issues.fix: Darken --action to #00307a and use it only on filled .btn backgrounds.

issues.problem: Fill vs ghost is fixed but both stay 48px pills, so WhatsApp still competes.
issues.fix: Restyle WhatsApp as a text .link (no border pill).

spacing_rhythm.evidence: Audit spacing_grid_adherence 100, spacing_distinct 8, radii 1, shadows 0. Mosaic gap is now var(--s2). .uses is a list, no columns:2. Who band still a single 62ch column on a full-width white section.
strengths: Desktop sections share 80px padding and 5/6 grid except .who

issues.problem: .who is not on the 5/6 grid; kicker/h2/p/ul are max-width 62ch, so the right half of the white band is empty.
issues.fix: At min-width 1024px set .who .wrap to display:grid; grid-template-columns:5fr 6fr; gap:var(--s7); put the directors list in the second column. Set .who padding-block to var(--s8).

issues.problem: --gut is still clamp(1.25rem,4vw,2.5rem), 20px min off the named scale.
